transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: What the hell do you think? I just got laid off and you're calling me about bills? Every damn time the phone rings it's someone wanting money! Leave me alone!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi, I’m Sarah. I’m really sorry — I can hear how overwhelming this is for you. I know this kind of call is the last thing you need right now, especially after everything you’ve just been through. That sounds incredibly tough, and I truly appreciate you telling me what’s going on. That takes courage.

I’m not here to pressure you or add to your stress — I promise. My job isn’t just about accounts or balances. It’s about listening, understanding where people are, and seeing how we can work together — even in hard times — to find something manageable.

Right now, you’re dealing with a lot, and the last thing you need is someone else making demands. So let me ask — not as a collector, but as a person — how are you holding up? I’m here to listen, and if you’re open to it, we can figure out a way forward that respects where you are right now.

Would that be okay? No pressure — just support.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: *sighs heavily* Look, Sarah... I ain't mad at *you* personally. But this whole damn system sucks. I worked hard my whole life, paid my bills on time, and the second I get knocked down — boom — everyone's got their hand out. I'm barely keeping the lights on. But... yeah, alright. I guess I can talk. Just don't hit me with some impossible payment plan, alright? I can't do what I can't do.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Thank you — I really appreciate you being honest with me, and for still being willing to talk. That means a lot, especially when you’re carrying so much. And you’re absolutely right — the system *does* feel broken sometimes. You did everything “right,” and still ended up here. That’s not fair. I see that. I *see* you.

This isn’t about impossible promises or numbers pulled out of thin air. It’s about *real*. It’s about what’s actually doable for you right now — even if it’s small. Because the truth is, I don’t expect you to fix everything overnight. Nobody should.

So let’s just talk — no scripts, no pressure. What does your world look like these days? What’s coming in, what’s going out, and what space — if any — is there for this debt right now? And if nothing’s possible this month, that’s okay too. We can talk about a pause, a reset, or a tiny step forward. Whatever feels honest to you.

This is your plan. Your life. I’m just here to walk beside you through it.
